mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 3 months are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 2% is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap and economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0% are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 3% YoY signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 3% is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
